card.name: Weekday names in news dates
card.fires_on: Weekday names (Tuesday, Wednesday) and the comma right after them in dateline-style dates, plus 'daily' in newsletter or resource phrases.

modes.label: Weekday and comma in dates
modes.description: A weekday name or the comma after it, just before a month and day in a news date.

modes.label: The word daily
modes.description: 'Daily' in newsletter or daily-resource lines on web pages.
modes.example: Your<< daily>> resource for losing weight and staying fit.

card.plain: It lights up on the day of the week at the start of a news date, such as Tuesday, 7 October.
